Name: Small Forest Farm
Author: nanisnigad
Description:
[size=4][b]A Small Forest Farm[/b][/size]

Made for single player, but you can still do multiplayer - 4 total players

Additional Mods Needed - SMAPI & Content Patcher

Warning: This Map [u][b]REPLACES[/b][/u] the [u]Forest/Foraging Farm[/u]. If you have another Mod that does this as well, it will [b]NOT[/b] work at the same time. You need a [b]NEW [/b]save file too, will not work on existing save files.
[u][b]NOT[/b] tested[/u] if works with other mods except my own.

[size=4][u][b]Notes:
[/b][/u][/size][list]
[*]I made this map to simply be a smaller Forest Farm, to make single player harder.
[/list][list]
[*]The only tillable spots are the dirt spots just like the original game.
[*]Bushes are not removable like the OG Forest Farm (working on fix but) - You can use the Destroyable bushes mod by Esca-MMC
[*]There are no custom tiles used, so recoloring mods [u]SHOULD[/u] work. I don't use any so I have not tested.

[/list]
